root_contract_notes: Root read the pinned tile scorer and mask derivation source. Submission parser accepts a list or an object with a results list; it does not accept an unwrapped single row.

Tile pairs deduplicate; integer type check admits booleans and does not validate bounds. Precision/recall/F1 use zero for zero denominators, including both empty sets. contains_tumor is not used by this scorer.

Best mask page is chosen for the analysis scale; tile boundaries are scaled and rounded into that page and clipped. Hidden label-2 count divided by actual nonempty patch size must reach 0.2. The cropped final-row height is source geometry, not a known positive label.
